description: Creative constraints library - Unexpected directions that force innovation beyond obvious solutions

color_restrictions.description: Color palettes that break from trendy defaults and force thoughtful design

constraints.name: monochrome_true
constraints.description: Strict monochrome - one color plus black and white
constraints.why_effective: Forces typography, spacing, and structure to carry meaning. Fast load, timeless.

constraints.name: single_accent
constraints.description: Neutral base (grayscale) with exactly ONE accent color
constraints.why_effective: Prevents color chaos. Accent gains meaning through rarity. Print-friendly.

constraints.name: warm_only
constraints.description: No blues, purples, cyans - warm tones only
constraints.why_effective: Breaks the 'tech = blue' default. Feels grounded and human.

constraints.name: paper_ink
constraints.description: Paper backgrounds with ink colors (black, deep colors)
constraints.why_effective: References print design. Readable. Reduces eye strain.

constraints.name: inverted_high_contrast
constraints.description: Black background, white content only - pure contrast
constraints.why_effective: Maximum readability. No ambiguity about hierarchy. Works in bright light.

interaction_sources.description: Unexpected domain inspirations that create fresh interaction models

constraints.name: architectural
constraints.description: Navigation and structure inspired by buildings, circulation, and spatial design
constraints.why_effective: Web is already spatial - use real spatial thinking instead of abstract metaphors.

constraints.name: biological
constraints.description: Interactions inspired by organisms, cells, and natural systems
constraints.why_effective: Organic yet structured. Patterns exist for reasons, not just decoration.

constraints.name: musical_structure
constraints.description: Rhythm, tempo, and musical structure applied to UI
examples: Beats per minute as interaction speed
constraints.why_effective: Tempo creates flow without animations. Time becomes a design element.

constraints.name: mechanical
constraints.description: Machine, tools, and physical interactions as digital metaphors
constraints.why_effective: Physical intuition transfers to digital. Feels solid and manipulable.

constraints.name: textual_first
constraints.description: Typography IS the interaction, not just content
constraints.why_effective: Text is fast, accessible, and flexible. Design = language.

technical_constraints.description: Technology restrictions that force creativity through limitation

constraints.name: css_only
constraints.description: No JavaScript except absolute essentials (form submission)
constraints.why_effective: Fastest possible. Works with scripts disabled. True progressive enhancement.

constraints.name: system_fonts_only
constraints.description: No web fonts - only default system fonts
constraints.why_effective: Zero network request for fonts. Familiar. User's preferred rendering.

constraints.name: no_images
constraints.description: No raster or vector images - everything via code
constraints.why_effective: Instant load. Scalable. Design = implementation skill.

constraints.name: single_file
constraints.description: All CSS, JS, HTML in one file - no imports
constraints.why_effective: Zero network requests. Portable. Copy-paste deployable.

constraints.name: no_animations
constraints.description: No transitions, animations, or transforms - instant changes
constraints.why_effective: No motion sickness. Crisp. Focus on content, not effects.

constraints.name: ascii_art_only
constraints.description: Visual elements created from text characters only
constraints.why_effective: Terminal aesthetic. Works in any browser. Ultra-fast. Retro yet modern.

context_shifts.description: Designing for unexpected contexts reveals what actually matters

constraints.name: print_first
constraints.description: Must work perfectly when printed - no hover-dependent information
constraints.why_effective: Forces true hierarchy. Accessible. Documentation-friendly.

constraints.name: screen_reader_first
constraints.description: Perfect experience without seeing - semantics, not visuals
constraints.why_effective: Actually accessible, not 'accessible' checklist. Clean mental model.

constraints.name: outdoor_visible
constraints.description: Readable in direct sunlight - high contrast, large touch targets
constraints.why_effective: Realistic usage scenario. Mobile usage in parks, waiting, public transport.

constraints.name: slow_connection
constraints.description: Works on 2G or slower - minimal JS, progressive loading
constraints.why_effective: Global audience. Doesn't punish users with bad connections. Resilient.

constraints.name: low_energy
constraints.description: Dark mode default - OLED friendly, fewer pixels lit
constraints.why_effective: Battery life. Eye strain. Dark mode as energy choice, not just preference.

structural_constraints.description: Layout and structural rules that force unconventional organization

constraints.name: linear_only
constraints.description: Strict linear flow - no grids, no sidebars, no simultaneous panels
constraints.why_effective: Impossible to get lost. Clear reading order. Mobile-first by default.

constraints.name: no_headings
constraints.description: No h1-h6 tags - structure via typography and spacing
constraints.why_effective: Prevents heading spam. Forces genuine visual design. Flexible structure.

constraints.name: infinite_scroll
constraints.description: Single page, no pagination, infinite vertical scroll only
constraints.why_effective: Like a story. Immersive. No navigation decisions, just consumption.

constraints.name: component_isolation
constraints.description: Each component completely independent - no shared state, no layout coupling
constraints.why_effective: Modular. Portable. Testable. Prevents cascade failures.

constraints.name: max_width_extreme
constraints.description: Very narrow content width - 30-40 characters max
constraints.why_effective: Forces brevity. Intentional design choice. Like zines or old newspapers.
